name: Feature Graph
definition: A directed acyclic graph representing classified voxel models where each node is a feature (a non-empty cluster of voxels sharing specific label values) and each arc represents the inclusion relationship of voxel sets, directed from larger (ancestor) to smaller (descendant) features.
summary: The Feature Graph is a hierarchical DAG representing voxel models by nodes for labeled features and arcs for inclusion, explicitly modeling topological relationships to enable efficient multiresolution rendering.
